description: Establishment of a Sri Lankan High Commission in Wellington, New Zeeland
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-01-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In order to further develop the existing diplomatic relations between New Zealand and Sri Lanka, it has been recognized that it is appropriate to establish a Sri Lankan High Commission in Wellington, New Zealand and the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs to proceed accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet.
